records.title: Microgrids — Testing for microgrid monitoring, control, and energy management systems
records.reportedScope: Hardware-in-the-loop, commissioning and periodic testing for grid-connected and isolated microgrid monitoring, control and energy management systems
records.benchmarkRole: Primary external test-method baseline for microgrid control/EMS test programme design; map only the applicable clauses and test profiles after authorized standards access.
records.limitations: A published technical specification is not an open benchmark dataset, controller certification or evidence that a particular system conforms.

records.title: P2030.7 — Standard for the Specification of Microgrid Controllers
records.benchmarkRole: Track revision scope and future controller-function requirements; continue to identify predecessor edition explicitly until a replacement is published.
records.limitations: Active PAR is a project authorization, not a published replacement standard or conformance target by itself.

records.title: P2030.8 — Standard for the Testing of Microgrid Controllers
records.benchmarkRole: Track controller test procedure revision; retain the 2018 edition as the published predecessor until a replacement is issued.
records.limitations: Active PAR is not a published replacement standard or a benchmark dataset.

records.title: A benchmark model for power system restoration studies: Review and application
records.reportedScope: Six detailed restoration scenarios and a simulation framework for EMT and RMS studies; associated Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.17340051
records.benchmarkRole: High-value physical restoration scenario/data transfer target. Reproduce exact scenario and model versions, then compare qualified electrical solver outputs separately from resource scheduler outputs.
records.limitations: Paper is open access, but dataset license, exact downloadable files, model/tool versions and redistribution rights must be checked independently. It is a physical restoration comparator, not a direct RCPSP scheduling leaderboard.

records.title: Resilience-oriented restoration of distribution networks under typhoon-induced uncertainties with rolling-horizon co-optimization
records.reportedScope: Publisher assigns the article to Reliability Engineering & System Safety, Volume 278 Part 2, February 2027. Its DOI is 10.1016/j.ress.2026.113531. The abstract reports results on modified IEEE 33-node and 123-node feeders and restoration-time reductions of 23.7% and 15.1% against its own best-performing benchmark.
records.benchmarkRole: Forthcoming methodological comparator for decision-dependent uncertainty, feedback and rolling-horizon restoration. Use the published abstract for early planning only; reproduce the exact feeder variants, objective, uncertainty, baselines and compute budget after full method/data access.
records.limitations: As of the 2026-11-19 snapshot, the publisher lists this article in Volume 278 Part 2, February 2027. Do not describe it as a formally published 2026 issue article. Its DOI year is 2026. The reported improvements are specific to the paper's test setup and selected baselines; they are not directly comparable to synthetic asset-repair cases or field restoration.

records.title: The Transmission Grid Investment and Supply Chain Assessment Report 2026
records.reportedScope: European TSO investment pipeline survey 2026–2035 plus a parallel skilled-workforce survey. Reports at least 36 months for 245–420 kV transformer procurement; PST customization lead times above four years; HVDC supplier bookings through 2030; 3–5+ year lead times across raw materials, factories, vessels, ports and installation crews; nine of twelve workforce survey submissions identify skilled workforce availability as a key challenge.
records.benchmarkRole: Operational context for long-lead equipment, supplier concentration, manufacturing, port/vessel bottlenecks and specialist workforce capacity. Use only as a European survey profile; do not generalise to South Africa or treat as an algorithmic benchmark.
records.limitations: Survey scope is participating European TSOs and a small parallel workforce survey (12 submissions). The aggregate constraints do not provide per-supplier lead-time distributions, factory capacity datasets, or South African procurement distributions. Do not fabricate probabilities from these values.

records.title: A Two-Stage Stochastic Programming Model for Proactive Scheduling of Distribution Networks with Emergency Resource Participation
records.reportedScope: Two-stage stochastic mixed-integer programming coordinates pre-disaster quantity/location of mobile energy storage, repair crews and switching crews, then post-disaster sequential restoration on standard IEEE test systems. The paper reports 19.0% and 19.9% reductions in load-shedding cost on 33-node and 123-node cases against its own comparison setup.
records.benchmarkRole: Strong comparator for proactive resource pre-positioning and joint mobile-storage/repair-crew/switching-crew scheduling. Reproduce exact scenarios, assumptions, resource mobility, objective and baselines before comparison.
records.limitations: Paper-specific load-shedding-cost results are not directly comparable to our synthetic weighted-MWh recovery scheduler. The paper is a method comparator, not a reusable recovery dataset or evidence of field performance.

records.title: An IGDT-based robust model for service restoration of distribution networks by scheduling of multiple resources
records.reportedScope: Risk-averse information-gap decision theory robust optimization for distribution service restoration with mobile/fixed power resources and repair-crew groups; multi-objective MIQCP formulation and uncertainty-radius treatment.
records.benchmarkRole: Robust-optimization comparator for limited or poorly calibrated disruption data. Compare uncertainty-set semantics, conservatism, feasibility, service outcome and solve bounds on matched inputs.
records.limitations: Method paper and case-study model, not a public grid-restoration event dataset. The IGDT uncertainty radius and objective must be reproduced before comparisons; cannot be translated into calibrated failure probabilities.

records.title: A reliability-oriented model for optimal deployment of corrective maintenance crews in power distribution systems: A stochastic dynamic planning using Benders decomposition
records.reportedScope: Stochastic dynamic planning model for corrective maintenance crew deployment, using Benders decomposition to compare crew/depot deployment and restoration reliability/cost trade-offs.
records.benchmarkRole: Algorithmic comparator for dynamic crew deployment, depot/resource pre-positioning and decomposition scalability.
records.limitations: Method paper; not a public supplier or repair-event dataset. Must reproduce its system boundaries, reliability measures, scenario assumptions and compute settings before comparing.

records.title: Resilience-oriented post-earthquake restoration of substations: Repair sequencing and resource scheduling
records.reportedScope: Publisher assigns the article to Volume 278 Part 2, February 2027. The abstract describes connectivity-based functionality, minimum repair sets, Smith's rule intra-layer repair sequencing, bottleneck-first inter-layer sequencing and nested spare allocation. It reports 4,000 synthetic seismic scenarios (1,000 at each of four PGA levels), 25.0%–36.3% improvements in median resilience index over Global-Greedy, equal or lower median values than its MILP benchmark and about three minutes versus over 24 hours for MILP.
records.benchmarkRole: High-priority forthcoming comparator for topology-aware bottleneck-first sequencing and nested spares. Reproduce exact substation model and compare resilience trajectory separately from final restoration time; test the same distinction in our service-cascade bridge.
records.limitations: As of 2026-11-19 this is assigned to a February 2027 journal issue, not a formally published 2026 issue paper. Reported metrics are from the paper's own 220 kV substation/seismic test cases and cannot be compared directly with our synthetic transformer fleet. The paper's resilience index and restoration time are distinct metrics.
